tasks.label: Inspect PR 202 CI
tasks.command: gh pr checks 202 --repo ssotomayor/discordia; gh pr view 202 --repo ssotomayor/discordia --json headRefOid,headRefName,statusCheckRollup

tasks.label: Check local repo state
tasks.command: git status --short; git log -1 --oneline; git remote -v

tasks.label: Verify CI format and release clippy
tasks.command: cargo fmt --all --check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $env:RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+crt-static -C debug-assertions=off'; cargo clippy -p dioxusfun --all-targets -- -D warnings

tasks.label: Inspect local tray event API
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo\registry\src" -Directory | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Directory -Filter 'tray-icon-*' } | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -Filter '*.rs' | Select-String -Pattern 'pub enum TrayIconEvent|pub enum MouseButton|enum MouseButton' -Context 0,14 } | Select-Object -First 80

tasks.label: Confirm tray type re-export
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo\registry\src" -Recurse -Filter '*.rs' | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match 'dioxus-desktop-0\.7\.10' } | Select-String -Pattern 'trayicon|pub use tray_icon' | Select-Object -First 35 Path,LineNumber,Line

tasks.label: Verify release-profile clippy
tasks.command: $env:RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+crt-static -C debug-assertions=off'; cargo clippy -p dioxusfun --all-targets -- -D warnings

tasks.label: Run skipped server clippy checks
tasks.command: cargo clippy -p dioxusfun-protocol -p dioxusfun-server -p dioxusfun-bot -p dioxusfun-rendezvous --all-targets -- -D warnings

tasks.label: Run skipped server tests
tasks.command: cargo test -p dioxusfun-protocol -p dioxusfun-server -p dioxusfun-bot -p dioxusfun-rendezvous

tasks.label: Verify tray label change
tasks.command: cargo test -p dioxusfun tray_close_behavior -- --nocapture; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cargo fmt --all --check
